about.title: About Alquenta
about.intro: Alquenta is a property marketplace where owners and agencies publish listings directly, and anyone can browse and reach out as a client — no intermediaries in between.
about.audiencesSub: Publish or browse — the deal is always direct between both parties.
about.forOwnersDescription: Publish houses, apartments, offices, commercial spaces or land for rent or sale in minutes, and manage every listing — status, photos, videos — from your own dashboard.
about.forClientsDescription: Browse the full catalog, filter by type, location and price, and message owners directly. Every conversation stays in one thread, with a notification when they reply.
about.step1Description: Explore houses, apartments, offices, commercial spaces and land for rent or sale, filtered by type and state.
about.step2Description: Send a message directly from the listing — no middleman, no waiting.
about.step3Description: Chat back and forth in one conversation thread, with notifications when the other side replies, until you agree on the terms.
about.step4Description: The actual contract happens off-platform, between you and the property owner.
about.ctaSubtitle: Create your listing in minutes and start getting messages from real clients.

legal.termsIntro: These terms govern your use of Alquenta. By creating an account or browsing the catalog, you agree to them.
legal.termsSection1Body: Alquenta is a property marketplace: owners and agencies (admins) publish houses, apartments, offices, commercial spaces and land for rent or sale, and clients browse the catalog and contact them directly through the platform's messaging.
legal.termsSection2Body: You're responsible for the accuracy of the information on your account and for keeping your credentials secure. Admin accounts are responsible for the accuracy of the listings they publish.
legal.termsSection3Body: Alquenta does not verify, own or manage any listed property. Listings are created and maintained solely by the admin who publishes them.
legal.termsSection4Body: Alquenta only facilitates the initial contact and conversation between an admin and a client. Any rental agreement, sale, payment or contract is negotiated and executed directly between the parties, off-platform. Alquenta is not a party to that agreement and is not responsible for its outcome.
legal.termsSection5Body: Don't use Alquenta to publish false listings, harass other users, or attempt to access accounts or data that aren't yours.
legal.termsSection6Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of Alquenta after a change means you accept the updated terms.
legal.termsSection7Body: Questions about these terms? Reach out through the contact page.
legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains what information Alquenta collects and how it's used.
legal.privacySection1Body: Account details you provide (name, email, phone), the listings you publish as an admin, and the messages you exchange with other users through the platform.
legal.privacySection2Body: To operate the marketplace: show your listings to clients, deliver messages between conversation participants, send notifications, and keep your account secure.
legal.privacySection3Body: Messages you send in a conversation are visible to the other participant in that conversation. We don't sell your personal data to third parties.
legal.privacySection4Body: Alquenta uses a session cookie to keep you signed in. It's required for the platform to work and isn't used for advertising.
legal.privacySection5Body: We keep your account data while your account is active. You can request deletion of your account and associated data through the contact page.
legal.privacySection6Body: Questions about your data? Reach out through the contact page.
